name: Kraken BTC/USD microprice
description: For each fresh reconstructed Kraken level-two book, microprice is (ask times bid size plus bid times ask size) divided by total touch size. microprice_deviation_bps is (microprice minus the book midpoint) divided by that midpoint times 10000, so a positive value indicates touch-size pressure toward the ask. Ready output requires a complete positive uncrossed Kraken book no more than 10 seconds old. This identity is single-venue: it reads only Kraken inputs and is ready whenever the Kraken book is complete, uncrossed, and inside the staleness bound, independently of the other adopted spot venue. The blended `btc.external.*` reading of the same measurement stays the reference layer and continues to require every adopted venue (ADR 0024). Decimal outputs are rounded to eight places using round-half-to-even.
